//: Fixture MCP servers for workflows-openrouter.e2e.ts. REALISM CONTRACT: tool names, arg schemas and result FORMATS mirror the real connectors — gmail/google-calendar/google-drive are transcribed from packages/connectors/src/google/ (gmailRead/gmailSend/calendar/drive .ts — exact names, required args, and the exact result line formats incl. empty-state strings); linear/stripe/attio/fireflies/asana mirror the vendors' hosted MCP servers as publicly documented (mcp.linear.app list_issues; mcp.stripe.com list_payment_intents; mcp.attio.com kebab-case search-records/create-note; Fireflies fireflies_get_transcripts/_details; Asana asana_-prefixed tools). Results carry DISTINCTIVE fake-people PII on purpose: the spec asserts these values are re-redacted before the model sees them yet restored in the answer. Tools WITHOUT readOnlyHint are writes — the main write-confirmation window must fire for them.
